issue_context.title: Failure to update ARWN sensors
issue_context.body:
## The problem

ARWN sensors fail to update after receiving first message after boot of Home Assistant.

[Culprit line of code](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/homeassistant/components/arwn/sensor.py#L103). Note that the line of code being called is for a sensor that has already been initialized and should have its `self.hass` already set. 

## Environment

- Home Assistant Core release with the issue: 0.112.4
- Last working Home Assistant Core release (if known): 0.111
- Operating environment (OS/Container/Supervised/Core): Hassio
- Integration causing this issue: ARWN
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/arwn/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`

```yaml
- platform: arwn
```

## Traceback/Error logs

```txt
Exception in async_sensor_event_received when handling msg on 'arwn/temperature/Master Bedroom': '{"units": "F", "humid": 43, "sensor_id": "15454:A", "bat": 1, "temp": 75.4, "dewpoint": 10.7, "timestamp": 1594492811}' Traceback (most recent call last): File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/arwn/sensor.py", line 103, in async_sensor_event_received store[sensor.name].set_event(event) File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/components/arwn/sensor.py", line 126, in set_event self.async_write_ha_state() File "/usr/src/homeassistant/homeassistant/helpers/entity.py", line 283, in async_write_ha_state raise RuntimeError(f"Attribute hass is None for {self}") RuntimeError: Attribute hass is None for <Entity Master Bedroom: 75.4>
```

## Additional information
comments: Adding a check on the sensor prior to calling `set_event` seems like a possible workaround but I'm curious as to why it is now failing.
